query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a patch of wild dandelions, ended up covered in little yellow fluff that I’m still picking off his coat. I stopped at the corner café on my way home to grab an iced oat milk latte, and they had those new lavender shortbread cookies out, so I picked one up and it was way sweeter than I expected, I had to drink half my latte just to cut the sugar. I also spent 20 minutes on the bus trying to beat the new level of that puzzle game I’ve been playing, and I still couldn’t get past the last matching tile, it’s so frustrating. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone: my APN settings aren’t working properly, my SIM card is locked and asking for a PIN I don’t remember right now, and I just found out my line got suspended because I forgot to pay my overdue bill, could you help me sort all this out?
